ambiguities.text: The spec says stack, memory, and memSize are 'before' operation execution but does not clarify exact timing for all edge cases
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'before' means immediately prior to opcode execution, after any instruction fetch but before any state changes.

ambiguities.text: The 'error' field is described as containing 'error description' without specifying exact format or encoding
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume error field contains implementation-specific error string encoded as hex, with revert reasons extracted where available.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define behavior for precompiled contract calls in trace output
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume precompiled contracts are traced at the CALL level but internal execution is not traced opcode-by-opcode.

implicit_assumptions.description: Tracing is only enabled on dedicated debug/test nodes, not production RPC endpoints
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Exposing trace endpoints publicly creates severe DoS vulnerability due to expensive computation

implicit_assumptions.description: All major Ethereum clients implement the trace format consistently for differential fuzzing to work
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inconsistent implementations would prevent effective cross-client fuzzing and bug detection

implicit_assumptions.description: Trace output is trusted to accurately reflect actual EVM execution
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inaccurate traces could mask consensus bugs or security vulnerabilities during testing
